Heavy Rain Causes Flooding in Delhi-NCR

A prolonged period of heavy rain has caused flooding in the Delhi-National Capital Region (NCR), affecting several areas including Noida, Gurgaon, Faridabad, and Ghaziabad. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has warned that relief from the rain is unlikely today.
